benchmark: held-person and held-segment ALICE speech-to-EEG transfer

per_seed_group.selection: All seeds retained; the primary prediction is their fixed equal ensemble.

interpretation.statistical_scope: Two held listeners, two held segments from one story. No broad population confidence interval; correlated time samples are not independent replications.
interpretation.metric_normalizer: Full-training target scales are a fixed evaluation reference. Every low-label ridge fit uses only its labeled subset for target centering/scaling, then forecasts are converted to common reference units.
interpretation.timing: Centered EEG filter uses two seconds of future EEG; content encoders use bidirectional contexts. Offline stimulus-response prediction, not causal online attention detection.
interpretation.dataset_limitations: Author ICA/bad-flag estimation scope unknown; inherited recordings and metadata; one English audiobook, no classroom outcome labels.
interpretation.fairness: Identical held data, masks and metric normalization. Same TCN family, optimizer, seeds and steps; full has more input information and input-layer parameters.
